comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features on title, argument and OC_comments, and both require acknowledgment before divergence. The target of the acknowledgment differs. Feature 0 requires an explicit statement that the OP's initial premise, meaning the central starting claim or assumption, is valid, correct, reasonable or true. Feature 1 accepts any valid point, or any part of the OP's underlying view, so a narrower premise-specific acknowledgment is a subset of it. Feature 1 also requires that a disagreement actually follows in the same comment. Feature 0 only requires that the acknowledgment come before any divergence. The null rules differ as well: feature 0 returns null if title and argument are both missing, while feature 1 returns null if any needed OP context is missing.
